description: Source code implementing proxy configuration logic for network proxy resolution, including classes and functions for managing proxy rules, parsing proxy settings, and applying proxy configurations.

classes.name: ProxyConfig
classes.description: Represents network proxy configuration, including automatic and manual proxy rules, PAC URL, and system settings.

classes.name: ProxyConfig::ProxyRules
classes.description: Encapsulates proxy rules, including proxy lists per scheme, fallback proxies, and bypass rules, with methods to apply and parse rules.

methods.name: Apply
methods.description: Applies proxy rules to a given URL, determining the appropriate proxy configuration.

methods.name: ParseFromString
methods.description: Parses proxy rules from a string representation.

methods.name: Equals
methods.description: Checks equality between two ProxyRules instances.

methods.name: MapUrlSchemeToProxyList
methods.description: Maps a URL scheme to the corresponding proxy list, considering fallback options.

methods.name: MapUrlSchemeToProxyListNoFallback
methods.description: Maps a URL scheme to the proxy list without fallback consideration.

methods.name: GetProxyListForWebSocketScheme
methods.description: Returns the proxy list to use for WebSocket schemes, following RFC 6455 recommendations.
